notes: Recurring SJSU programs that aren't one-off events. Every entry was loaded from its official url on last_checked; window is the typical timing the page states, not a promised date.

programs.title: McNair Scholars Program
programs.description: Helps first-generation and/or limited-income students prepare for doctoral programs and conduct research with a faculty mentor. Applicants must have completed 60 units, be enrolled full-time, hold a minimum 2.8 cumulative GPA, and be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident.
programs.window: For the 2026-27 cycle, applications opened August 14, 2026 and are due November 20, 2026
programs.evidence: Application Status: Opens August 14th, 2026 ... Application Deadline: November 20th, 2026

programs.title: Student RSCA Fellowship
programs.description: A competitive fellowship that supports undergraduate and graduate students working with an SJSU faculty mentor, with an award of up to $3,000 for student salary and professional travel. Fellows attend monthly mentoring sessions.
programs.window: Offered annually; applications for the 2027-28 fellowship are due February 7, 2027
programs.evidence: Applications due February 7, 2027. ... The R&I SRF is offered annually, so you will be able to apply for the next cycle.

programs.title: Student RSCA Competition
programs.description: Undergraduate and graduate students present original research, scholarship, or creative activity and compete to represent SJSU at the CSU-wide Student Research Competition.
programs.window: Applications usually open in September and close in early February; semifinals run late February and March, with the CSU-wide competition in April
programs.evidence: Applications usually open in September and close in early February, so check back for updates.

programs.title: Undergraduate Research Opportunity Program (UROP)
programs.description: A yearlong program that pairs each student with a faculty mentor for one academic year, with a shared cohort experience and 4 elective units. It is open to incoming freshmen, rising sophomores, and new transfer students.
programs.window: Applications accepted during open enrollment, mid-April through early August; priority deadline July 1
programs.evidence: submit an application during the open enrollment period (i.e., mid-April through early August)

programs.title: SJSU Research Week and Celebration of Research
programs.description: An annual week showcasing research, scholarship, and creative activity across campus, including the Celebration of Research, where students have presented posters.
programs.window: Each April; Research Week 2027 is April 12-20, 2027
programs.evidence: SJSU Research Week: April 12-20, 2027

programs.title: Peer Educator Jobs at Peer Connections
programs.description: Peer Connections hires students as Peer Tutors, Academic Peer Mentors, Supplemental Instruction (SI) Leaders, and Learning Assistants. Tutors have usually earned an A or B in the course they support.
programs.window: Hires ahead of each semester; Spring 2027 applications are due October 31, 2026
programs.evidence: Applications for Spring 2027 are open. Applications are due: October 31, 2026.

programs.title: Writing Tutor Jobs at the Writing Center
programs.description: Undergraduate and graduate writing tutors work 5 to 20 hours a week leading one-on-one and small-group sessions online or in person, plus workshops. Applicants need clear academic standing, a 3.2 overall GPA, and a B or higher in first-year writing; pay starts at $20/hour for undergraduates and $21/hour for graduate students.
programs.window: Usually twice a year: late fall (to start in spring) and late spring (to start in fall)
programs.evidence: We usually invite applications for new writing tutors twice per year in the late fall (to start in the spring) and in the late spring

programs.title: Orientation and Transition Team (OATies)
programs.description: Team members serve as small group leaders during summer orientation sessions for first-year and transfer students and are paid $18.45/hour during the summer. Applicants must be current SJSU undergraduates in good standing with a minimum 2.5 SJSU cumulative GPA.
programs.window: Recruits in late summer; the 2027 team applications ran August 24 to September 16, 2026
programs.evidence: Applications open Monday, August 24, 2026 and close Wednesday, September 16, 2026.

programs.title: Resident Advisor and Housing Student Staff Positions
programs.description: University Housing Services hires live-in Resident Advisors and Theme Community Resident Advisors, plus hourly Peer Academic Success Coaches, Student Administrative Assistants, and Community Desk Assistants. Positions require full-time enrollment and a minimum 2.5 semester and cumulative GPA (2.85 for Peer Academic Success Coaches).
programs.window: Applications open November 2, 2026 and close January 25, 2027, with interviews in February
programs.evidence: Applications open: November 2, 2026 ... Applications close: January 25, 2027

programs.title: Student Union Student Jobs
programs.description: Student Union, Inc. hires enrolled SJSU students for roles in recreation, events, marketing, operations, customer service, and administration. Open positions are posted on its job board.
programs.window: Rolling; check the page
programs.evidence: one of the largest student employers on campus

programs.title: Associated Students Student Assistant Jobs
programs.description: Associated Students posts student assistant openings in areas such as the Child Development Center, General Services Center, Print Shop, and Government Department.
programs.window: Rolling; check the page
programs.evidence: Student Assistants

programs.title: On-Campus Jobs on Handshake
programs.description: Handshake is where students search on-campus jobs, apply for Federal Work-Study roles, find part-time off-campus work, and explore internships. Some departments, such as the Library, Writing Center, Student Union, and University Housing, also post openings on their own sites.
programs.window: Rolling; check the page
programs.evidence: Handshake is SJSU’s primary job board for student employment.

programs.title: Federal Work-Study
programs.description: Students with unmet financial need based on their FAFSA are considered for Federal Work-Study, and the award is paid only through an authorized work-study job. Students working after the spring term need a Summer FWS Clearance to work in June, July, and August.
programs.window: Awarded each year through the FAFSA; see the page for current dates
programs.evidence: Students who have unmet financial need based on their FAFSA will be considered

programs.title: Career Center Job and Internship Fairs
programs.description: The Career Center holds job and internship fairs in the Student Union Ballroom, including separate fairs for STEM undergraduates, business and non-STEM majors, health and public service, and a late spring fair for all majors. Registration is through Handshake.
programs.window: Spring 2027 fairs run February through April 2027; registration opens November 2, 2026
programs.evidence: Registration for the SJSU Spring 2027 Career Fairs will open on Monday, November 2, 2026.

programs.title: Career Center Events and Workshops
programs.description: The Career Center runs career education events, employer info sessions and tabling, and workshops throughout the semester, listed on its events page.
programs.window: Each semester; the event listing updates daily
programs.evidence: See a sampling of career fairs, events, and workshops to help you make the most of the semester.

programs.title: Recognized Student Organizations
programs.description: SJSU recognizes over 350 student organizations across academic, club sports, cultural and religious, fraternity and sorority, and special interest categories. The current list is kept in the SAMMY App.
programs.window: Year-round; see the page for current dates
programs.evidence: recognizes over 350+ student organizations

programs.title: Weeks of Welcome
programs.description: A campus-wide series of welcome events at the start of the term, including Ask Me tables and a kickoff event, with a WOW group in the SAMMY App.
programs.window: Start of the semester; fall 2026 ran August 19 to September 30
programs.evidence: WOW is a campus-wide celebration powered by the Spartan community!

programs.title: Associated Students Elections
programs.description: Students elect three Executive Officers (President, Vice President, and Controller) and ten Directors, who serve as the governing council for Associated Students.
programs.window: Each spring semester
programs.evidence: The A.S. Student Elections happen in the Spring semester.

programs.title: Associated Students Committees
programs.description: A.S. committees are open to all SJSU students, and student-at-large members vote on policies and initiatives. Students apply through the A.S. committee application form for the academic year.
programs.window: Applications for the 2026-27 year are on the page; committees meet during the fall and spring semesters
programs.evidence: Associated Students committees are the driving force behind impactful policies and initiatives within student government.

programs.title: SJSU Spartan Scholarship Application
programs.description: The Spartan Scholarship application is SJSU's scholarship application for the academic year. International students are eligible only for merit-based scholarships.
programs.window: See the page for current dates
programs.evidence: The 2026-2027 SJSU Spartan Scholarship Scholarship Application is now open.

programs.title: Associated Students Scholarships
programs.description: A.S. awards scholarships of $750 to $1,500, including the First-Generation Student Scholarship, Legacy Award, and Pursuit of Black Excellence Scholarship. Applicants must have completed at least 15 semester units at SJSU and hold a 2.5 cumulative GPA (2.75 for the Legacy Award).
programs.window: See the page for current dates
programs.evidence: matriculated students who have completed a minimum of 15 semester units at SJSU

programs.title: A.S. Key Leader Award
programs.description: Recognizes up to 12 student leaders who empower others, with recipients honored at the SJSU Student Leadership Gala. Nominees need at least 12 completed semester units and a 2.5 cumulative GPA.
programs.window: Nominations open each spring; the last cycle's deadlines fell in late March and early April
programs.evidence: Please check back in Spring 2027 when the nomination forms reopen.

programs.title: Phi Kappa Phi Honor Society
programs.description: Membership is by invitation only and open to the top 7.5% of juniors and the top 10% of seniors and graduate students.
programs.window: See the page for current dates
programs.evidence: The top 7.5% of Juniors are eligible

programs.title: Semester and Year Study Abroad Programs
programs.description: Students apply through the Spartans Abroad Portal for semester or year programs such as SJSU Exchange, CSU International Programs, NSE, and ISEP.
programs.window: For fall or academic-year programs, most applications are due February 15 (ISEP Exchange March 1); for spring-only or calendar-year programs, September 15
programs.evidence: SJSU Exchange: February 15 ... SJSU Exchange: September 15

programs.title: Faculty-Led Short-Term Study Abroad
programs.description: SJSU runs faculty-led study abroad programs in summer and winter, along with Summer School Abroad and Global Internship programs, each with its own application timeline.
programs.window: Summer 2027 faculty-led applications are due February 3, 2027; winter programs were due in early September
programs.evidence: Applications Due : February 3, 2027 at 11:59pm PT

programs.title: Transfer Student Orientation
programs.description: A required one-day orientation for admitted transfer students to get familiar with campus and connect with other incoming students. Students first complete the Spartan Link online orientation module.
programs.window: Summer sessions before the fall term; the page lists dates in July and early August
programs.evidence: All admitted transfer students must attend one orientation session

programs.title: Transfer Success Pathway (TSP)
programs.description: A dual admission program for eligible first-time, first-year California Community College students who commit to transferring to a CSU within three years.
programs.window: Each year from August 1 to September 30
programs.evidence: Agreements can be submitted from August 1 to September 30.

programs.title: Registration and Add/Drop Deadlines
programs.description: The Registrar publishes a registration calendar for each term with registration, add/drop, and payment deadlines.
programs.window: Each fall, winter, spring, and summer term
programs.evidence: Staying informed about registration and payment deadlines is essential to your academic success.
